messages:
maria: quick flag  catalog index links to /models/zephyrxl#limits but the model card header is '## Sequence limits' so the anchor is #sequence-limits. also the SDK snippet under 'long-context tips' still uses the legacy generate() call.
aj: ok. sounds like three fixes: update catalog link, add an anchor shim on the card, and swap the snippet to the responses API.
sam: I can do a tiny PR. proposed snippet change:
```python3
from redwood import Client
import os
client = Client(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])
resp = client.responses.create(model="zephyr-xl", input="Summarize: ...", max_output_tokens=512)
print(resp.output[0].content)
```
jen: mkdocs supports `{#limits}` so add `### Limits {#limits}` under the Sequence limits header to keep old external links working. also add a one-sentence note about 8-bit quant variants having reduced effective context.
docbot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821  fixes catalog link, adds anchor shim, updates snippet. CI running.
sam: lint fixed, preview looks good. merging once CI green.
docbot: PR merged by sam  https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821  deployed to staging.
maria: created docs-ship ticket to add a short SDK migration mapping generate() -> responses.create in the migration guide and to note helper fields vs raw response shapes. aj will draft.
aj: will drop a short blurb today. thanks!
